note: v1, written: SECOND STREAM. Deep dub techno at 124 bpm in D minor (the style board's t8 row). A 909 kick whose tail feeds a pumped RUMBLE bus (a hall, low-passed at 170 Hz and driven), the sub on the off-beats, open hats on every off-beat, and closed 16ths accented every fifth - doubled by a metal hat on the accents, FIVE OVER FOUR walking across the bar. A song-local DUB CHORD stab (D minor 9, mutating by phrase: Dm9 -> Dm11 -> Bb and Gm colours) on the and-of-one goes into THE ROOM, a feedback echo chamber (3/16 delay -> 1.9 kHz low-pass -> tape, fed back at 0.74). STREAM SPLIT: the dry stab sinks while the room's send rises, so in the break - no kick, the hall frozen - the dotted-eighth echoes are the loudest rhythm left and the ear takes them as the beat, until the kick slams back in B. Form: intro 16, build 16 (a Shepard riser into A), A 32, break 16, B 32 (the ride), peak 16 (claps), outro 16 - 4:43. The master is pushed to the album's louder target (rms -14.6, crest 8.4). compscore seeds 0/11/19/29: 88.238/88.445/88.321/88.734.
